City Clinic — Consultation Note

Chief Complaint: Fever and cough for 3 days
History: Low-grade fever, productive cough, no breathlessness.
On Examination: Temp 100.4 F, throat congested, chest clear.
Assessment: Acute bronchitis
Plan: Azithromycin 500 mg once daily for 3 days, steam inhalation
Follow-up: Review after 5 days if symptoms persist
